title: 第267章 总裁卡，非洲心！！目标一把三千万！！
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

按照正常思路出生在宿舍，那肯定是要第一时间去看西大的。

哪怕你不架点，不抽人。

光是拿到一手西大有没有出生人，以及过没过的信息，这就已经很重要了。

因为在航天基地这张地图，是二员与宿舍必刷，然后西大、中控、发射三刷二的。

如果要是西大没刷人，那就是中控和发射必刷，你就可以提前知道外场可能会有架打，

以及离心大概率会有人等等与接下来你的对局思路有关的信息。

但他们现在可不是在正常打，而是在跑刀啊！

而且还是两个哈吉蜂，开局就有两颗大烟作掩护。

要是出生在其他地方的话可能还需要考虑的东西多一点，出生宿舍那就只有一个字——吃！

而也正因如此，我们的杨起家才在下飞机之后头也不回的走向了正前方航空箱的位置，

并一摸就摸出来了个三乘三，只是目前还不知道具体是什么而已。

“别搞啊哥，说好的唐王号，你不能给我一个甲吧！”

虽然正常来说的话，

说不管你玩的什么爆率的号，再怎么样的唱衰自己，在看到容器里三乘三的时候也还是会十分期待，

会期待里面是一个大红的！

但杨起家或许是被上一个号摧残太惨了，他此时在看见三乘三之后竟然心里下意识觉得这就不是个大货，

他竟然这就是和别人反过来，一边嘴里说着不希望这是个甲，一边又觉得这玩意就是个甲！

而也就是当他眼巴巴的看着眼前的眼前这个九格一直在转，在加载超过一秒后，

一股基本上压抑不住的狂喜伴随着他眼前被屏幕映照出的一抹红色而喷涌而出了！

“卧槽！！真是红！”

“曼德尔超算单元一个！宝贝～”

“哈哈哈，我出红了，我终于出红了啊，哈哈哈！”

此时，终于看到自己出了大货的杨起家就好像是当年范进中举一般，差点就要手舞足蹈起来了！

只见他第一时间就把这个曼德尔超算拉进了自己的九格保险之中，

本以为自己将要化作无畏战士，毕竟他这把可是纯纯卡战备进来的，

就算是现在西大有人，没走，选择了闪击他也敢直接拿着枪去跟人跳拉。

他本来以为自己是能有这个勇气的。

但随着这个航空箱内后续刷新出来的其他东西，他又感觉....当个怯战蜥蜴好像也不是不行？

“啊！？”

“量子储存一个宝贝！”

“啊！？高级咖啡豆！？实验数据！？”

“一个容器四个红？？”

“卧槽！这....这什么啊？这号什么东西啊！这真是有脏东西吧卧槽！”

没错，除了刚一出来就被杨哥装进保险的九格曼德尔超算单元二百多万以外，

他紧接着就又在这同一个容器里又开出了三个红，分别是制作刘涛的必需品，非卖品——高级咖啡豆，

二十万出头的小红实验数据和量子储存！

以及后续还有一个特别稀有，连他玩了这么多把三角洲都很少爆出来，

以一介小金之身媲美，在价值上甚至超越小红。

是铸造夜视五级头盔的必要品——镜头！

就这一套下来他说实话，即使高级咖啡豆这种非卖品它不好衡量具体价值，

但咱们就按照最保守的，按照万足金条的三十五万价值来计算。

三十万+二十二万+二十一万+二十五万。

小小一个航空箱，竟然让他吃到了除去放在保险的曼德尔超算，还有一百多万的价值在保险之外，

这让他怎么能不当场化身怯战蜥蜴啊！

讲个笑话，一个容器吃到本场收益三百万，这特么是认真的吗？

给你吃到真的航空箱了？

“那什么，蜂医哥，你过来一下。”

“你裤兜里还有位吗，要不你先来把这几个小红小金装起来呗？我这一个曼德尔超算单元实在装不下了啊！”

杨起家一边招呼着去吃另外两个宿舍的蜂医出来，一边丢出了自己身上的这几个小红并标记了一下，

等到对方刚吃完一个楼真过来了后，他又一副假装毫不在意的模样在蜂医面前秀起了自己手里的曼德尔超算。

本以为会迎来对方羡慕的眼光，毕竟跑刀仔之间的比拼肯定就是比谁更能出货，

肯定就不是比谁杀的多了。

而且要知道的是，对面蜂医这一把可是玩的他上把那个大黑号啊！

那个又黑又神，巴可是遇到三个小麦，航天吃完三个核心区才一共三个金的超级大黑号！

According to the normal thinking, if you were born in a dormitory, you would definitely go to Western University as soon as possible.

Even if you don't stand up or slap people.

Just getting the first-hand information on whether anyone was born at Western University and whether they passed or not is already very important.

Because in this map of the aerospace base, two members and the dormitory must be cleared, and then Western University, Central Control, and Launcher must clear the other two.

If Western University doesn't brush anyone, then the center control and launcher must be brushed. You can know in advance that there may be a fight in the outfield.

And there is a high probability that someone will wait for information related to your next game idea.

But now they are not fighting normally, but running knives!

And there are still two Haji Bees, and there are two big smokes as cover at the beginning.

If you were born in another place, you may have to consider a little more. If you were born in a dormitory, there is only one word - eat!

And because of this, our Yang Qijia walked towards the flight box directly in front of him without looking back after getting off the plane.

And as soon as I touched it, I found a three by three, but I don't know what it is yet.

"Don't do it, brother, you can't give me the title of Prince Tang, can you?"

Although normally speaking,

No matter what account you play with a high explosive rate, no matter how badmouthing you are, you will still look forward to it when you see three times three in the container.

I would expect a big red one inside!

But Yang Qijia may have suffered too much from the previous number. After seeing three times three, he subconsciously felt that this was not a big deal.

He turned out to be the opposite of others, saying that he didn't want it to be an A, but at the same time he felt that this thing was an A!

And that is when he watched eagerly as the nine frames in front of him kept spinning. After loading for more than one second,

A surge of ecstasy that was basically uncontrollable spurted out along with the flash of red reflected on the screen in front of his eyes!

"Damn!! It's so red!"

"One Mandel supercomputing unit! Baby~"

"Hahaha, I'm famous, I'm finally famous, hahaha!"

At this time, Yang Qijia, who finally saw that he had made a big deal, was like Fan Jin who passed the exam, and almost started dancing!

I saw that he immediately pulled this Mandel supercomputer into his nine-frame insurance.

I thought I was going to turn into a fearless warrior, after all, this was a pure card he had prepared for war.

Even if someone from Xida didn't leave and chose to blitz, he would still dare to jump with the gun directly.

He originally thought he could have the courage.

But as other things were subsequently refreshed in this flight box, he felt... It seemed that it was not impossible to be a timid lizard?

"Ah!?"

"Quantum storage is a treasure!"

"Ah!? High-end coffee beans!? Experimental data!?"

“Four reds in one container??”

"Holy shit! What...what is this? What the hell is this! This is really dirty, isn't it!"

That's right, except for the more than 2 million Jiuge Mandel supercomputing unit that was put into insurance by Brother Yang as soon as it came out,

He then opened three more reds in the same container, which were the necessities for making Liu Tao and not for sale-high-grade coffee beans.

Xiaohong’s experimental data and quantum storage cost over 200,000 yuan!

And there is another one that is very rare in the follow-up. Even after playing so many Deltas, he rarely reveals it.

It is comparable to Xiaojin, and even surpasses Xiaohong in value.

It is a necessary item for casting a level 5 night vision helmet - lens!

In this way, he told the truth, even if high-end coffee beans are not for sale, it is difficult to measure the specific value.

But let’s calculate it based on the most conservative calculation, based on the value of 350,000 gold bars.

Three hundred thousand + two hundred and twenty thousand + two hundred and one hundred thousand + two hundred and fifty thousand.

A small flight box actually allowed him to eat. Apart from the Mandel supercomputer placed in the insurance, there was still more than one million worth of it in the insurance.

How could he not turn into a timid lizard on the spot?

To tell a joke, one container earned 3 million in revenue. Is this serious?

Did you get a real flight box?

"What about that, Brother Bee Doctor, come here."

"Do you still have room in your trouser pocket? Why don't you pack up these little red and gold ones first? I really can't fit this Mandal supercomputing unit in it!"

While Yang Qijia called the bee doctors who were going to eat in the other two dormitories to come out, he threw out the few red ones on his body and marked them.

When Lou Zhen came over after the other party had just finished eating, he pretended not to care and showed off the Mandel Supercomputer in his hand in front of the bee doctor.

I thought I would get envious looks from the other side. After all, the competition between knife-slingers must be to see who can deliver the goods better.

It's definitely not about killing more people.

And what you need to know is that the bee doctor on the opposite side is playing his big black number!

That black and awesome one, Bacco met three wheats, and the three core areas of Aerospace were eaten to only get a total of three gold super big black numbers!
